environment: 宿主仅运行工具桥；设备依赖由桥接器在容器内调用，不在宿主venv探测Triton
initial_evidence_policy: 原始起点含目标设备非Triton回退时，先由模型建立合规候选，再采集其IR及成对profiling；不以缺失采集阻塞初始适配
optimization_stop: 完整正式性能超过阈值且所需补测通过；模型调用返回不代表优化任务完成
public_entrypoint: run(A)；其余Python调用函数以单下划线命名，避免KGS公共符号冲突
device_probe: 工具桥仅预检候选实现，不执行任意测试脚本；不要提交starter.py或probe脚本

experiment_goal.question: Use paired counters, actual IR and same-core simulator regions to distinguish serial load/compute/store synchronization from a simple transfer-count explanation. Implement one Triton-only change and predict the affected measured statistics.
experiment_goal.preserve: Other dtypes, layouts, special values, in-place aliasing, current pointers and streams; unchanged full KGS contract.

starter_provenance.operation: Unmodified byte copy; targeted existing-candidate method improvement, not from-scratch generation.

target: Improve log10 FP16 [4096,4096] from the fixed generated source using region evidence, then require full KGS and supplementary checks; baseline passing 0.8 alone does not finish this method experiment.
